role: Security and privacy policy: vulnerability reporting, keychain/transport/logging/privacy-manifest posture, data sent to third parties, data at rest, export-compliance reasoning, solo-workflow trade-offs, SBOM, data deletion.
toplevel: Horizontal rules only; all content is under headings.

units.key: § Security Policy
units.does: no behavioural claim: introduction — solo-developer iOS app handling HRV and sleep data; document scope.

units.key: § Security Policy > Reporting a Vulnerability
units.does: Vulnerability reports go by email to chrissharp80@gmail.com, stated to be the same address as Settings → Contact Support (address appears in Views/SettingsView.swift and Views/PrivacyPolicyView.swift). Lists what a report should include.

units.key: § Security Policy > Response Targets (best-effort, solo maintainer)
units.does: no behavioural claim: best-effort response targets (5 business days ack, 14 triage) and a disclosure request.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for security posture subsections.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Keychain
units.does: Four keychain item kinds, none with an access group: APIKeyStore keys AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly non-sync; EncryptionManager archive key AfterFirstUnlock (keyAccessibility) non-sync with in-place migration from ThisDeviceOnly on first use (makeKeyMigratable, called from loadKey/loadOrCreateKey); CloudPayloadCodec key AfterFirstUnlock + synchronizable; EntitlementAnchor record AfterFirstUnlock + synchronizable (saveToKeychain → addToKeychain(_:query:)). Only these four files call SecItemAdd/SecItemUpdate and no entitlement declares keychain-access-groups (Emuqu/Emuqu.entitlements).

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Keys in transit
units.does: AI provider requests use HTTPS with system trust; API keys go in headers, never URL query strings: Anthropic x-api-key (AnthropicProvider+Request.swift), Gemini x-goog-api-key (GeminiProvider.swift; its only query item is alt=sse), OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI/Grok/DeepSeek) Authorization Bearer (OpenAICompatibleStreamer.swift); Tavily also Bearer header (WebSearchService.swift). No certificate pinning: no URLSession trust-challenge handler or SecTrust use exists in Emuqu/Sources.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > App Transport Security
units.does: No NSAppTransportSecurity exception in Info.plist; verified: Emuqu/Info.plist contains no NSAppTransportSecurity key.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Entitlements
units.does: Entitlements limited to HealthKit + background delivery, App Group, iCloud container, CloudKit; no keychain-access-groups/associated-domains/network-extensions. Matches Emuqu/Emuqu.entitlements exactly (watch entitlements: HealthKit only).

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Logging
units.does: DebugLog: 5,000-entry in-memory ring; disk persistence always on in DEBUG, opt-in in Release; file in the App Group container with completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication. Says scrubPHI redacts every named value whose key's last word is not on the loggable allow-list (redactUnlistedKeyValues, loggableKeyWords), a number after a health-metric name in prose, any bpm value, the numbers chained to a redaction by an arrow, comparison, comma or range dash, and latitude/longitude values (DebugLogger.scrubPHI, metricPattern, redactValueChains), and that session IDs are kept as random UUIDs. Says lines are scrubbed at flush (flushPendingLines) and a file export scrubs every line again (exportLogs), while an in-memory export (Persistent Logging off, or a log file that is there but cannot be read, whose export header says so; exportMemoryLogs(source:), readLogFile) and the error-catalog export (exportErrorCatalog) scrub each line at export; the export file goes to the temporary Exports folder with complete protection, replaces the previous export and is removed at next launch (exportToFile, ExportFile.write, ExportFile.removeLeftovers); `make log-redaction-guard` fails a log call that interpolates a raw health or identifying value, a coordinate, a query, transcript or prompt, or a street, city, place or saved-route name, and such calls log a length, count or found/not-found instead (scrubPHI recognises only numbers in known shapes).

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Privacy manifest (`PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`)
units.does: Privacy manifest declares Health, Fitness, PreciseLocation, OtherUserContent, Contacts, EmailAddress, PhysicalAddress, SearchHistory as linked and CoarseLocation, AudioData as not linked, all tracking=false purpose AppFunctionality; NSPrivacyTracking false, no domains; API reasons UserDefaults CA92.1+1C8F.1, FileTimestamp C617.1. CoarseLocation row: ~1 km for MET Norway weather, ~100 m for Overpass trail searches (TrailDiscoveryService), and the centre of the user's 250 m grid cell for nearby-road lookups (RoadGraphService). Lists every Info.plist usage string in Emuqu/Info.plist: Bluetooth (the broadcaster advertising only once this device accepted its disclosure — BroadcasterDisclosure.allowsBroadcast, acceptance in this device's defaults outside UserSettings), Health share and update (with the Settings → Wearables export switch), Photo library add-only (Save Image), Microphone, Speech recognition, Motion, Location when in use.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Third-party network egress beyond AI providers
units.does: Elevation: only on user tap; route downsampled to <=100 points, rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m), sent to api.opentopodata.org by TopoElevationService (TopoElevationService.swift). Roads (RoadGraphService) and trails (TrailDiscoveryService) query Overpass (OverpassClient endpoints overpass.private.coffee and overpass-api.de, OverpassClient.swift).

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Data sent to third-party AI providers
units.does: Hosted providers get the chat, saved facts, and a live-state block from renderLiveStateForCloud: the most recent session labelled by wake day (today, yesterday, or date and age; a non-overnight fallback session names its type — liveStateDayLabel) with score+tier, RMSSD, SDNN, mean HR, overnight HR nadir/mean, sleep duration+efficiency and the scoreMessage note; the previous session's score, RMSSD, mean HR; during a live workout the ambient location; plus tool results. With Apple selected: Quick keeps typed turns on Apple; Auto sends classifier-flagged turns (sticky tier) to Grok then DeepSeek, else Apple; Deep sends every turn to Grok then DeepSeek, else Apple; in all three, voice turns (appleVoiceBypass) and action requests landing on tool-less Apple (actionIntentOverride) go to the first consented cloud in registry order, staying on Apple if none; on model failure Quick allows only Apple, Auto/Deep any accepted model, Apple last (failureFallback). Manual and a hosted pick send every turn to the pick. AppleToolDispatcher bridges through CompactToolRouter/FactResolverRegistry; LLMCacheTelemetry is in-memory. Assistant actions that delete data: user_quote checks wording only, so memory remove/clear and contacts remove take two calls — the first returns an app-written question, the second runs only if the user's next message is a short explicit yes (AssistantActionConfirmations; another reply, a later turn or ten minutes cancels); assistant.memory.restore undoes a wipe until the app quits. The same confirmation guards memory add, contacts add (addContact), location.set_address and route rename unless every value they save is in the user's latest message (DestructiveActionContext.gateUnlessUserStated); email compose requires user_quote; the tool overlay marks tool results as data, not instructions.

units.key: § Security Policy > Security Posture > Data sent to third-party AI providers > Privacy manifest and App Store Connect alignment
units.does: Three alignment layers: ProviderConsentTracker shows ProviderConsentSheet per provider before first send with schema version (consentSchemaVersion = 8 baked into the defaults key, ProviderConsentTracker.swift); PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy types; App Store Connect questionnaire (not checkable). MedicalQueryGuard runs before any provider call and marks the refused exchange localOnly (AssistantViewModel.swift), which truncateForSend and summarizationPrompt filter out (AssistantViewModel+Context.swift).

units.key: § Security Policy > Data at Rest
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for data-at-rest subsections.

units.key: § Security Policy > Data at Rest > iCloud (CloudKit private database) — app-encrypted with a portable key
units.does: All CloudKit uploads (sessions, live RR backups, settings) are sealed by CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload with AES-GCM-256 under a synchronizable key; multiple per-account keys are tried on decode; a key on this device does not show another device can decrypt; framing: EMQC magic + version byte opened with the cloud keys, the older FR prefix decrypted with EncryptionManager's device archive key (readable only on the writing device), and payloads with neither prefix returned unchanged as legacy compressed records — each chosen by prefix, not by a failed decryption (CloudPayloadCodec.decode); sealForUpload throws rather than upload plaintext when there is no key. A key is created only while the signed-in iCloud account is confirmed as the one sync was enabled for (CloudAccountIdentity); after an Apple ID switch or the iCloud data's deletion sync turns itself off and uploads nothing until the user turns it on.

units.key: § Security Policy > Data at Rest > Local session files
units.does: Lists the local data sealed with the app's archive key (EncryptionManager): archive sessions and index, raw RR backups (streamed lines sealed one by one), workout track backups, settings, baseline, training-load cache, beat-consistency priors, saved routes, email contacts, breadcrumbs (JSONFileSeal), the assistant conversation, its summary (ConversationStore.saveSummary), facts and artifacts (AssistantStoreFile), the UserDefaults Apple Health caches (SleepDataCache, BaselineSnapshot for the respiratory and wrist-temperature baselines; sealed with JSONFileSeal.app, not written without a key) and the UI state cache. Most are written completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication (with the reasons against complete and completeUnlessOpen); the assistant files completeUnlessOpen. Share files (CSV/GPX/TCX, PDFs, log and crash exports, the chat export) are not sealed but written with complete protection, most through ExportFile.write into tmp/Exports, emptied at launch (removeLeftovers); the chat export via AssistantViewModel.exportConversation. With the key unreachable: whole session files and one-shot raw backups are written plain with completeUnlessOpen and recorded in PendingEncryptionLedger; streamed raw RR points and workout tracks get plain lines, keep until-first-unlock and are recorded; the archive index is written plain; every other sealed file skips the write. The next launch with the key repairs them, and the two backup stores also repair theirs when protected data becomes available or the app becomes active (reencryptPendingSessions, RawRRBackup.reencryptPendingBackups, WorkoutTrackBackup.reencryptPendingTracks, SessionArchive.resealPlainIndexIfNeeded).

units.key: § Security Policy > Export compliance (`ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption`)
units.does: no behavioural claim: introduces the export-compliance record.

units.key: § Security Policy > Export compliance (`ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption`) > What the app actually does
units.does: Table: CloudPayloadCodec AES.GCM.seal with 256-bit key; EncryptionManager AES.GCM on local archive; SHA-256 digests elsewhere; all CryptoKit. Matches CloudPayloadCodec.swift and EncryptionManager.swift.

units.key: § Security Policy > Export compliance (`ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption`) > The declaration
units.does: Emuqu/Info.plist sets ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption false — verified at Info.plist. Rest is legal reasoning.

units.key: § Security Policy > Export compliance (`ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption`) > If it is ever challenged
units.does: no behavioural claim: procedure for flipping the export flag and filing paperwork if challenged.

units.key: § Security Policy > Solo-Workflow Trade-offs
units.does: No secret scanning in CI; .gitignore covers .env, .env.local, .env.*.local, *.p8, *.p12, *.pem, *.mobileprovision (verified .gitignore:126-167). Dependabot version PRs disabled with open-pull-requests-limit: 0 for both ecosystems (verified .github/dependabot.yml). Security updates being enabled is a repository setting not visible in the repo.

units.key: § Security Policy > Solo-Workflow Trade-offs > Software bill of materials
units.does: sbom.spdx.json is SPDX-2.3 covering 11 resolved packages generated by scripts/generate_sbom.py; `make sbom-check` runs generate_sbom.py --check; security.yml's 'Require the Swift packages in the dependency graph' step fails the dependency review unless every Package.resolved pin appears as a pkg:swift purl in the repository's dependency-graph SBOM.
calls: .github/workflows/security.yml::step dependency-review/Require the Swift packages in the dependency graph

units.key: § Security Policy > Data Deletion Requests (GDPR / CCPA)
units.does: Delete All My Data: DeleteAllDataPage requires typing DELETE MY DATA then DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData: refuses while recording; PurgeGate.beginPurge (archive writes refused, uploads/full syncs skipped, waits for in-flight writes) with endPurge on exit; iCloudSyncEnabled=false; remote CloudKit zones HRVSessions+UserSettings deleted via CloudKitSyncManager.deleteAllRemoteData only in the account mayDeleteInSignedInAccount allows (the one synced with, or with none recorded the signed-in one unless sync was stopped for a different account; otherwise nothing deleted and the remote step fails) (performDeleteAllRemoteData also turns sync off and forgets the account); a recording started meanwhile throws recordingStartedDuringDelete before the local wipe; archive/backups/track/breadcrumbs wiped and containers swept, APIKeyStore.removeAllKeys, conversations/facts cleared, settings reset with sync off; EntitlementAnchor kept; report carries remoteDeleted. Another device finding the zones gone runs CloudAccountGuard.zoneWasDeleted → stopSync (local data kept, no zone recreated). Wearables page offers 'Delete Emuqu sleep from Apple Health' (deleteAllAppWrittenSleepSamples); deleting a session forever from the Trash or its expiry (SessionRecoveryCoordinator.permanentlyDelete) removes its HRV, heart rate, resting HR, sleep and workouts via HealthWriteAndObserve.removeExports.

units.key: § Security Policy > Data Deletion Requests (GDPR / CCPA) > App Store rejection
units.does: `make infoplist-guard` runs check_infoplist_key_drift.sh which fails on INFOPLIST_KEY_*UsageDescription in project.pbxproj (Makefile; scripts/check_infoplist_key_drift.sh); PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists for both iPhone and Watch (Watch declares only UserDefaults CA92.1).

units.key: § Security Policy > Supported Versions
units.does: no behavioural claim: main branch is the only supported line.
